files.meaning: Source inventory; growth alone is not deterioration.
files.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

functions.meaning: Includes named functions, nested callbacks and test scopes.
functions.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

lines.physical.meaning: Physical source lines; size-only languages included.
lines.physical.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

lines.code.meaning: ESLint code lines for supported scripts only.
lines.code.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

fileLines.mean.meaning: File code size; splitting is not automatically an improvement. Average across measured items.
fileLines.mean.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

fileLines.p95.meaning: File code size; splitting is not automatically an improvement. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
fileLines.p95.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

fileLines.max.meaning: File code size; splitting is not automatically an improvement. Largest observed value.
fileLines.max.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

fileBytes.mean.meaning: UTF-8 byte size of each inventoried source file; large files deserve a boundary review. Average across measured items.
fileBytes.mean.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

fileBytes.p95.meaning: UTF-8 byte size of each inventoried source file; large files deserve a boundary review. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
fileBytes.p95.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

fileBytes.max.meaning: UTF-8 byte size of each inventoried source file; large files deserve a boundary review. Largest observed value.
fileBytes.max.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

largeFiles.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

coverage.sizeOnly.meaning: Files measured only for physical size.
coverage.sizeOnly.why: Expose gaps so missing relationships do not look like improved independence.

coverage.unresolved.meaning: Unknown relationships; reductions may reflect code deletion or changed resolution.
coverage.unresolved.why: Expose gaps so missing relationships do not look like improved independence.

coverage.errors.why: Expose gaps so missing relationships do not look like improved independence.

immutability.constData.meaning: Module-level const objects/arrays with nested literal data; this is a scope inventory.
immutability.constData.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

immutability.mutableConstData.meaning: Module-level nested const data without a deep-readonly marker; these values remain writable through their references.
immutability.mutableConstData.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

functionLines.mean.meaning: Executable function code size; blank and comment-only lines are excluded. Average across measured items.
functionLines.mean.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

functionLines.p95.meaning: Executable function code size; blank and comment-only lines are excluded. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
functionLines.p95.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

functionLines.max.meaning: Executable function code size; blank and comment-only lines are excluded. Largest observed value.
functionLines.max.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

nesting.mean.meaning: ESLint block depth; lower is a simpler-control-flow signal. Average across measured items.
nesting.mean.why: Keep the number of conditions a reader must hold in mind manageable.

nesting.p95.meaning: ESLint block depth; lower is a simpler-control-flow signal. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
nesting.p95.why: Keep the number of conditions a reader must hold in mind manageable.

nesting.max.meaning: ESLint block depth; lower is a simpler-control-flow signal. Largest observed value.
nesting.max.why: Keep the number of conditions a reader must hold in mind manageable.

callDepth.mean.meaning: Calls nested inside arguments or receivers; callback bodies measured separately. Average across measured items.
callDepth.mean.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

callDepth.p95.meaning: Calls nested inside arguments or receivers; callback bodies measured separately. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
callDepth.p95.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

callDepth.max.meaning: Calls nested inside arguments or receivers; callback bodies measured separately. Largest observed value.
callDepth.max.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

callbackDepth.mean.meaning: Maximum nesting of inline callback functions; each callback adds one level. Blocks are measured separately. Average across measured items.
callbackDepth.mean.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

callbackDepth.p95.meaning: Maximum nesting of inline callback functions; each callback adds one level. Blocks are measured separately. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
callbackDepth.p95.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

callbackDepth.max.meaning: Maximum nesting of inline callback functions; each callback adds one level. Blocks are measured separately. Largest observed value.
callbackDepth.max.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

visualDepth.mean.meaning: Visual control-flow depth: inline callbacks plus per-function block depth. Advisory only. Average across measured items.
visualDepth.mean.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

visualDepth.p95.meaning: Visual control-flow depth: inline callbacks plus per-function block depth. Advisory only. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
visualDepth.p95.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

visualDepth.max.meaning: Visual control-flow depth: inline callbacks plus per-function block depth. Advisory only. Largest observed value.
visualDepth.max.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

parameters.mean.meaning: Explicit inputs can replace hidden dependencies; fewer is not always better. Average across measured items.
parameters.mean.why: Make required inputs visible without encouraging oversized input objects.

parameters.p95.meaning: Explicit inputs can replace hidden dependencies; fewer is not always better. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
parameters.p95.why: Make required inputs visible without encouraging oversized input objects.

parameters.max.meaning: Explicit inputs can replace hidden dependencies; fewer is not always better. Largest observed value.
parameters.max.why: Make required inputs visible without encouraging oversized input objects.

largeFunctions.meaning: Executable functions above the 40-code-line review signal.
largeFunctions.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

captures.mean.meaning: Dependencies outside function parameters; imports and closures included. Average across measured items.
captures.mean.why: Expose hidden inputs and reliance on state outside the function.

captures.p95.meaning: Dependencies outside function parameters; imports and closures included. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
captures.p95.why: Expose hidden inputs and reliance on state outside the function.

captures.max.meaning: Dependencies outside function parameters; imports and closures included. Largest observed value.
captures.max.why: Expose hidden inputs and reliance on state outside the function.

captures.mutable.meaning: Function/binding observations; not writes or object mutability.
captures.mutable.why: Expose hidden inputs and reliance on state outside the function.

captures.module.meaning: Captured dependencies by origin; assess locality and reuse.
captures.module.why: Expose hidden inputs and reliance on state outside the function.

captures.closure.meaning: Captured dependencies by origin; assess locality and reuse.
captures.closure.why: Expose hidden inputs and reliance on state outside the function.

captures.import.meaning: Captured dependencies by origin; assess locality and reuse.
captures.import.why: Expose hidden inputs and reliance on state outside the function.

capabilityMembers.mean.meaning: Named parameter members accessed; a larger input object may conceal coupling. Average across measured items.
capabilityMembers.mean.why: Reveal how much of an input object a function really needs.

capabilityMembers.p95.meaning: Named parameter members accessed; a larger input object may conceal coupling. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
capabilityMembers.p95.why: Reveal how much of an input object a function really needs.

capabilityMembers.max.meaning: Named parameter members accessed; a larger input object may conceal coupling. Largest observed value.
capabilityMembers.max.why: Reveal how much of an input object a function really needs.

compliance.candidates.meaning: Functions subject to strict limits; file-level metric exemptions are honored per metric.
compliance.candidates.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

compliance.nonCompliantFunctions.meaning: Unique executable functions exceeding at least one configured strict limit.
compliance.nonCompliantFunctions.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

compliance.violations.meaning: Strict limit breaches; one function may contribute several violations.
compliance.violations.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

compliance.lines.meaning: Functions exceeding the configured code-line limit.
compliance.lines.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

compliance.nesting.meaning: Functions exceeding the configured block-nesting limit.
compliance.nesting.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

compliance.callDepth.meaning: Functions exceeding the configured nested-call limit.
compliance.callDepth.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

compliance.callbackDepth.meaning: Functions exceeding the configured callback-depth limit.
compliance.callbackDepth.why: Put complexity changes in the context of code size; growth alone does not mean worse quality.

edges.call.meaning: Distinct directed endpoint/kind pairs; call and reference can describe the same connection.
edges.call.why: Track how many other pieces must be understood to change this code.

edges.reference.meaning: Distinct directed endpoint/kind pairs; call and reference can describe the same connection.
edges.reference.why: Track how many other pieces must be understood to change this code.

edges.import.meaning: Distinct directed endpoint/kind pairs; call and reference can describe the same connection.
edges.import.why: Track how many other pieces must be understood to change this code.

edges.type-import.meaning: Distinct directed endpoint/kind pairs; call and reference can describe the same connection.
edges.type-import.why: Track how many other pieces must be understood to change this code.

connections.meaning: Distinct directed function pairs, deduplicating call/reference observations.
connections.why: Track how many other pieces must be understood to change this code.

fanOut.mean.meaning: Direct dependency breadth; legitimate decomposition can increase it. Average across measured items.
fanOut.mean.why: Track how many other pieces must be understood to change this code.

fanOut.p95.meaning: Direct dependency breadth; legitimate decomposition can increase it. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
fanOut.p95.why: Track how many other pieces must be understood to change this code.

fanOut.max.meaning: Direct dependency breadth; legitimate decomposition can increase it. Largest observed value.
fanOut.max.why: Track how many other pieces must be understood to change this code.

fanIn.mean.meaning: Caller breadth; high fan-in can indicate valuable reuse. Average across measured items.
fanIn.mean.why: Identify shared helpers and code whose changes could affect many callers.

fanIn.p95.meaning: Caller breadth; high fan-in can indicate valuable reuse. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
fanIn.p95.why: Identify shared helpers and code whose changes could affect many callers.

fanIn.max.meaning: Caller breadth; high fan-in can indicate valuable reuse. Largest observed value.
fanIn.max.why: Identify shared helpers and code whose changes could affect many callers.

reach.functions.mean.meaning: Dependencies reachable within two steps; static observations only. Average across measured items.
reach.functions.mean.why: Estimate how far a reader or change may need to travel through the code.

reach.functions.p95.meaning: Dependencies reachable within two steps; static observations only. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
reach.functions.p95.why: Estimate how far a reader or change may need to travel through the code.

reach.functions.max.meaning: Dependencies reachable within two steps; static observations only. Largest observed value.
reach.functions.max.why: Estimate how far a reader or change may need to travel through the code.

reach.files.mean.meaning: Files reachable within two steps, including imports. Average across measured items.
reach.files.mean.why: Estimate how far a reader or change may need to travel through the code.

reach.files.p95.meaning: Files reachable within two steps, including imports. At least 95% of items are at or below this value.
reach.files.p95.why: Estimate how far a reader or change may need to travel through the code.

reach.files.max.meaning: Files reachable within two steps, including imports. Largest observed value.
reach.files.max.why: Estimate how far a reader or change may need to travel through the code.

cycles.functions.meaning: Strongly connected groups including recursion; inspect members.
cycles.functions.why: Find pieces that depend on each other and may be difficult to understand or change separately.

cycles.files.meaning: Mutually dependent files; fewer indicates less cyclic coupling.
cycles.files.why: Find pieces that depend on each other and may be difficult to understand or change separately.

isolatedFunctions.meaning: No observed edges; callback/framework connections may be missing.
isolatedFunctions.why: Expose gaps so missing relationships do not look like improved independence.

boundaries.file.meaning: Cross-file connections include function pairs and import observations.
boundaries.file.why: Find bridges between responsibilities and judge whether related code stays together.

boundaries.folder.meaning: Cross-boundary resolved function connections; imports excluded.
boundaries.folder.why: Find bridges between responsibilities and judge whether related code stays together.

boundaries.package.meaning: Cross-boundary resolved function connections; imports excluded.
boundaries.package.why: Find bridges between responsibilities and judge whether related code stays together.

boundaries.submodule.meaning: Cross-boundary resolved function connections; imports excluded.
boundaries.submodule.why: Find bridges between responsibilities and judge whether related code stays together.

clusters.discovered.meaning: Fresh discovery; more clusters is not inherently better.
clusters.discovered.why: Find bridges between responsibilities and judge whether related code stays together.

clusters.singletons.meaning: Often unresolved callbacks, not proof of independence.
clusters.singletons.why: Find bridges between responsibilities and judge whether related code stays together.

clusters.crossings.meaning: Crossings against saved borders during comparison; new/unmatched functions excluded.
clusters.crossings.why: Find bridges between responsibilities and judge whether related code stays together.

clusters.unassigned.meaning: Unmatched functions have no saved border; crossings may be understated.
clusters.unassigned.why: Find bridges between responsibilities and judge whether related code stays together.

clusters.crossingRatio.meaning: Percentage of resolved function pairs crossing the compared borders; unassigned endpoints excluded.
clusters.crossingRatio.why: Find bridges between responsibilities and judge whether related code stays together.
